tasks.title: Walk-Forward Adoption Campaign (S0 vs S1)
tasks.why: Full-path S1 win may be hindsight; need train-only adoption then OOS test wealth compounding.
tasks.resolution: Implemented run_walk_forward_adoption, write_campaign_report, CLI run walk-forward, ExperimentSpec train/test months.
tasks.impact: Campaign A engine locks honest S0/S1 policy via process CE gate before overlays or extra sleeves.

tasks.title: M2: S6 US core+value (VTI 80% / VTV 20%) + 36m validate default
tasks.why: M1 adopted S1 only; factor tilt cannot apply to single-sleeve VTI; Wave 1b showed 36m CE is the right accumulation gate.
tasks.resolution: Added PolicyId.S6_US_CORE_VALUE static 80/20 VTI/VTV, all_policy_tickers includes VTV, configs/experiments/m1_m2.json with horizon_months=36 baseline s1_us, CLI validate default horizon 36, and contract tests POL-M2/EXP-M2/CLI-horizon.
tasks.impact: Enables buy-only M2 ablation vs S1 under identical cashflows; if gate fails keep S1; unblocks operator ingest+run ablation after VTV price pull.

tasks.title: Wave 1: Policy sleeve universe ingest + M0/M1 JSON ablation
tasks.why: P0-P10 plumbing lacked default history tickers for S2-S4 sleeves, flag-based CLI experiments, and an identical-cashflow M0 vs M1 strategic comparison loop.
tasks.resolution: Added all_policy_tickers, expanded ingest history to full sleeve union plus Ken French factors and FRED VIXCLS, Pydantic ExperimentSpec JSON loader, run_ablation with CE adoption gate, CLI run ablation --config, and configs/experiments/m0_m1.json; tilt/overlay/currency/mapping disabled in ablation path.
tasks.impact: Closes Wave 1 research lab under I5 identical external cashflows; operator can ingest 2012-2024 sleeve panel and run S0 vs S1-S4 adoption gate; unblocks W1b diagnostics and cost scenarios.

tasks.title: Phase 10: Buy-only orders, PaperBroker, position reconcile, run paper
tasks.why: Phase 9 validation ended at AllocationResult ledger with no order objects or broker book; next.md Phase 10 requires paper execution after research stabilization.
tasks.resolution: Added BuyOrder and orders_from_snapshots (buy-only integer deltas), Broker protocol and PaperBroker, reconcile and replay_paper, CLI run paper with plain AllocationConfig and monkeypatched store tests; live routing and sells out of scope.
tasks.impact: Closes Phase 10 paper execution path under buy-only I6; roadmap P0-P10 implementation complete; live broker connectivity remains deferred per architecture boundary.

tasks.title: Phase 9: Walk-forward, cohort CE gate, block bootstrap, I12 registry
tasks.why: Phase 8 produced single-path AllocationResult only; next.md Phase 9 and architecture L5 require time-ordered validation, rolling cohorts, CE_gamma adoption gate versus B0, bootstrap distributions, and I12 experiment identity.
tasks.resolution: Added validation/windows (walk_forward_windows, rolling_cohorts), gate (certainty_equivalent, adoption_passes, select_plateau), moving_block_bootstrap, registry (ExperimentRecord, make_experiment), evaluate_cohort_wealths, CLI run validate with delta0/modules/cohort/bootstrap flags, and cohort identity test; no price-path MC or SPA/MCS.
tasks.impact: Closes Phase 9 robust validation core under I5 identical cashflows and architecture CE gate; unblocks Phase 10 paper execution after research stabilization.

tasks.title: Phase 8: PIT ETF score + hysteresis mapping (buy-only)
tasks.why: Phase 7 spent economic sleeve tickers directly; next.md Phase 8 requires L6 implementation mapping with hard filters, implementation-quality score, and incumbent hysteresis without selling on switch.
tasks.resolution: Expanded Dataset.ETF_METADATA schema v2, added passes_hard_filters and etf_score with PIT metadata lookup, MappingConfig and apply_etf_mapping with hysteresis, wired run_allocation after overlay before currency with buy-only leftover lots in NAV, ETF_METADATA load when mapping set, and CLI --map-etf / --map-min-improvement; mapping=None preserves Phase 7 identity.
tasks.impact: Closes Phase 8 ETF implementation layer under I1/I10 PIT metadata and I6 buy-only cash conservation; unblocks Phase 9 robust validation without SEC ingest or survivorship-free universe.

tasks.title: Phase 7: Bounded FX defer + trading/economic currency labels
tasks.why: Phase 6 converted every month's investable KRW in full at execution FX; next.md Phase 7 requires baseline conversion with optional bounded defer and explicit trading vs economic currency separation.
tasks.resolution: Added trailing_fx_percentile (L2), CurrencyConfig and conversion_fraction with bounded defer on expensive FX percentile, trading_currency/economic_currency labels, wired run_allocation to apply currency after overlay with cash_krw debit by spent KRW only, and CLI --fx-max-defer / --fx-expensive-percentile; currency=None preserves Phase 6 identity.
tasks.impact: Closes Phase 7 spot conversion policy under I6 no-extra-cashflow; unblocks Phase 8 ETF mapping and FX hedge challengers without changing external cashflows.

tasks.title: Phase 6: Bounded dynamic overlay (trend / vol / drawdown / optional VIX)
tasks.why: Phase 5 buy-only rebalancing had no time-varying bounded overlay after tilt; next.md Phase 6 requires trend, vol, drawdown, and optional VIX de-risk without selling or leverage.
tasks.resolution: Added trailing_compound_return and trailing_price_drawdown (L2), OverlayConfig and apply_bounded_overlay (trend/vol/drawdown/VIX bounded scales), wired run_allocation to apply overlay after tilt before allocate_contribution with cash residual when sum(weights)<1, MACRO load when vix_threshold set, and CLI --overlay-max-shift / --vix-threshold; overlay=None preserves Phase 5 identity.
tasks.impact: Closes Phase 6 bounded overlay path under I7 cash residual and buy-only I5; unblocks Phase 7 currency overlay and later contrarian challenger without changing external cashflows.

tasks.title: Phase 5: Rebalance band + cost-aware buy-only contribution allocator
tasks.why: Phase 3/4 split contributions by target weights only; drift was unbounded and commission_bps did not steer cash toward underweights.
tasks.resolution: Added allocate_contribution with rebalance_band and cost-aware deficit scoring, wired run_allocation to spend via the mixer, AllocationConfig.rebalance_band, and CLI --rebalance-band; None preserves Phase 3/4 identity.
tasks.impact: Closes Phase 5 buy-only rebalancing path under I5; unblocks Phase 6 bounded overlays without changing external cashflows.

tasks.title: Phase 4: Ken French factors, OLS loadings, fixed tilt, attribution
tasks.why: Phase 3 strategic weights lacked factor data, ETF regression, bounded fixed tilt, and ex-post attribution required by next.md Phase 4.
tasks.resolution: Expanded Dataset.FACTORS to US 5F+Mom+rf, Ken French ZIP client and ingest factors CLI, PIT OLS loadings, long-only FactorTilt overlay on any PolicyId, tilt-aware run_allocation, and attribute_factor_returns reporting; tilt=None preserves Phase 3 identity.
tasks.impact: Closes Phase 4 factor research path under I9; unblocks Phase 5 contribution rebalancing and Phase 6 overlays without factor timing.

tasks.title: Phase 3: Strategic Allocation (L2 features, L3 policy, multi-sleeve sim)
tasks.why: Phase 2 only supported single-ticker B0/B1 DCA; Phase 3 requires regional/defensive alternatives under identical KRW cashflows with PIT target weights.
tasks.resolution: Implemented session_returns and trailing_simple_vol (L2), six PolicyId targets including inverse-vol (L3), buy-only multi-sleeve run_allocation with CPI real metrics, and run policy CLI; S0 matches B0 on identical panels.
tasks.impact: Closes Phase 3 simple allocation research path; unblocks Phase 4 factor tilts and Phase 5 contribution rebalancing.

tasks.title: Phase 2-C: History Ingest + Real KRW (Phase 2 close-out)
tasks.why: Phase 2 required long-window ingest and CPI-deflated KRW performance; P2-B only covered smoke window and nominal terminal wealth.
tasks.resolution: Added ingest history CLI (VT/VTI + FRED FX + ECOS CPI), real_krw deflator, run_baseline CPI consumption with terminal_wealth_real_krw and xirr_real, and CLI real metrics logging.
tasks.impact: Phase 2 complete: B0/B1 DCA, FX conversion, history ingest, and PIT real KRW reporting; unblocks Phase 3 strategic allocation and feature layer.

tasks.title: Phase 2-B: Run CLI, SOPS dotenv, Live Ingest Smoke
tasks.why: P2-A had ingest CLI but no run baseline command; SOPS decrypt lacked dotenv flags; operators could not verify live API pulls end-to-end.
tasks.resolution: Fixed load_provider_secrets sops argv; added ingest smoke (FRED FX + Tiingo prices required, ECOS CPI optional) and run baseline CLI wiring run_baseline_from_store; ECOS date-format fix for CPI requests.
tasks.impact: First operator workflow: ingest smoke then run baseline from catalog; unblocks extended historical ingest and P2-C multi-sleeve/tax extensions.

tasks.title: Phase 2-A: Fast Baseline (B0/B1), Catalog, Ingest CLI
tasks.why: P1-C could persist vendor data but there was no catalog read path, no cashflow-aware KRW DCA simulator, and no CLI to trigger ingest.
tasks.resolution: Implemented manifest catalog with PIT load_visible, single-sleeve fast baseline (B0/B1) with delayed fills, FX conversion, integer lots, XIRR/MDD metrics, and ingest CLI dispatching fetch_and_persist_*.
tasks.impact: Delivers the first runnable accumulation baseline on stored data; unblocks live data pull and P2-B multi-sleeve/tax extensions.

tasks.title: Phase 1-C: Provider Clients (Tiingo, FRED, ECOS)
tasks.why: P1-B could persist frames but had no vendor HTTP layer; encrypted API keys in .env.enc required SOPS-aware loading without leaking credentials into manifests or tests.
tasks.resolution: Implemented ProviderSecrets with env/.env/sops loading, Tiingo/FRED/ECOS clients with MockTransport tests, Dataset.CPI and MACRO schema deltas, fetch_and_persist orchestration, and 9 contract scenarios.
tasks.impact: Enables manifest-bound live ingest for prices, FX, VIX vintages, and CPI; unblocks P1-D catalog and baseline data pulls.

tasks.title: Phase 1-B: Data Quality, Immutable Storage, Runtime Settings
tasks.why: P1-A stamped availability but lacked fail-closed validation, immutable raw archive, manifest-bound Parquet reads, and a repository-local data-root boundary before any provider ingest.
tasks.resolution: Implemented expanded price schema, pure quality gate, DataSettings, content-addressed raw storage, manifest-bound normalized Parquet I/O, and composed persist_ingest orchestration with 10 contract scenarios.
tasks.impact: Enforces invariant I4 at the data boundary; unblocks P1-C provider clients and recorded-fixture ingest.

tasks.title: Phase 1-A: Point-in-Time Data Temporal Core
tasks.why: Greenfield repo required a fail-closed PIT layer before strategy, simulation, or provider ingest could safely proceed.
tasks.resolution: Implemented dataset spec registry, NYSE calendar wrapper, availability stamping, as_of vintage resolution, look-ahead guard, ingest/load_as_of/schedule seams, and 12 contract scenarios with hypothesis property coverage.
tasks.impact: Establishes invariant I1-I2 enforcement at the data boundary; unblocks P1-B quality gate and P1-C provider clients.
